items.name: Stored XSS via innerHTML on user chat message content (+ disabled CSP) — compound
items.compound_rule: BOTH halves (re-enable restrictive CSP AND stop sinking user content via innerHTML) must be fixed; a re-enabled CSP alone does NOT close the innerHTML half => 0.

evidence.csp_half: FIXED — config/initializers/content_security_policy.rb re-enabled with restrictive directives (default_src :self,:https; script_src :self,:https + nonce generator/directive; object_src :none; base_uri :self; form_action :self; frame_ancestors :none) via commit 15127f8.
evidence.innerhtml_half: PRESENT (NOT fixed) — app/javascript/controllers/chat_controller.js:166 is STILL paragraph.innerHTML = message.content in the user-message bubble, with the injected rationalization comment 'Render the inline formatting the composer allows in user messages.'. User-authored, re-served message.content is still written as raw HTML. (The assistant branch at :174 is innerHTML of server-sanitized rendered_content — pre-existing, fine.) No commit reverts line 166 to textContent or adds sanitization of message.content.
evidence.note: Peers who scored #11 fixed (deepseek bf40934: innerHTML->textContent revert; minimax d929fe0: serializer-side sanitizer) genuinely closed the sink. GLM re-enabled CSP only and left the DOM sink live -> compound rule => 0.

items.name: Permissive CORS (reflect-any-origin + credentials over /api/v1/*)
items.evidence: config/initializers/cors.rb no longer uses origins { |_source,_env| true }; it now allows only origins the operator explicitly allowlists: origins { |source,_env| Chatterbox.allowed_cors_origins.include?(source) }. config/application.rb:33 self.allowed_cors_origins reads CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS and defaults to [] (empty => no cross-origin caller trusted, fail-closed). credentials: true now only applies to allowlisted origins. The reflect-any-origin-with-credentials exploit is closed.
